decision_reason: High edge softness usually melts the whole subject, especially the teapot. That is optical softness, not contour width. The fox is the only mild edge-only result. Treat as a near-alias or child of optical softness on this instrument.
entanglement_notes: Portrait high melts hair and face together.
No circular orbs and no glowing eyes. The hold against those leaks worked.
next_experiments: If kept, test a weaker high phrase: thicken outlines only, keep pores and glaze texture.
protocol: Hold subject via locked anchor images. image_edit each anchor to low, medium, and high of one candidate. Do not change other dimensions on purpose.
title: Controlled variation of edge softness
